1. identityConsistency - 2: Players are reduced to abstract colored blobs, losing all structural detail like limbs and kit numbers.
2. motionFidelity - 3: The general spatial arrangement of players shifts plausibly between the two stylized frames.
3. stylizationStrength - 4: The flow-prop-toon effect is very bold and clearly applied across the entire scene.
